propositions: Backfill complexity and clone-count metrics by sampling historical commits and running measurement tools at each sampled point.
Snapshot timestamps must reflect the sampled commit's committer date (via git show), not the wall-clock backfill-run time, to preserve meaningful trend history.
A commit whose measurement tool fails or is absent is skipped without aborting the entire backfill; the script logs the skip and continues.
All written snapshots are tagged with source=snapshot and confidence=high, and must contain integer-typed complexity and clone_count fields.
The measure_tree function is a seam point that can be monkeypatched in tests to return stub values, eliminating external tool dependencies from test execution.
